_note: Example messages written by hand for the demo. They are not taken from any dataset and are not used for training or for accuracy numbers.

samples.label: Bank KYC (SMS)
samples.text: Dear customer, your SBI account will be blocked today. Update your KYC immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/login

samples.label: Electricity bill
samples.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm because your previous month bill was not updated. Please contact our electricity officer 9876543210 immediately. Thank you.

samples.text: This is Inspector Sharma from CBI. Your Aadhaar is linked to a money laundering case. You are under digital arrest. Join the video call now and do not tell anyone. Transfer Rs 2,00,000 for verification.

samples.label: PayPal e-mail
samples.text:
Subject: Your account has been limited

Dear customer,

We noticed unusual activity in your PayPal account. Your account has been limited. Please log in to verify your identity within 24 hours or your account will be suspended.

https://paypa1.com/signin?country=IN

Thank you,
PayPal Security Team
